properties.name: app.time-zone
properties.description: IANA zone of the application clock, schedule and monitoring defaults, console timestamps and the zone named in prompts. Empty uses the machine's zone. Applied while the environment is prepared; the JVM default zone is set to match.

properties.name: agent.local-account.slack-workspace-id
properties.description: Slack workspace ID of the installation's owner, so the console and that person's Slack messages share one account. Blank with a blank user ID selects the console-only account. Set both or neither.

properties.name: agent.local-account.slack-user-id
properties.description: Slack user ID of the installation's owner; see agent.local-account.slack-workspace-id.

properties.name: agent.concurrency.max-active-roots
properties.description: Installation-wide maximum active root workers, including unsettled cancelled operations. Children share their root's slot.

properties.name: agent.concurrency.queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum newly queued root admissions. FIFO queue tickets persist in MongoDB; excess admission fails before commit. Recovered existing work is retained when capacity decreases.

properties.name: inference.concurrency.max-requests
properties.description: Installation-wide maximum concurrent provider requests across all profiles and auxiliary inference, including token counting and open streams.

properties.name: inference.concurrency.queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum waiting provider requests in the shared FIFO. Full queues fail before provider dispatch.

properties.name: inference.concurrency.max-wait-millis
properties.description: Maximum standalone provider queue wait. Task requests instead use their caller's remaining task deadline; cancellation remains interruptible.

properties.name: agent.code-execution.enabled
properties.description: Enable isolated synchronous Python execution. Disabled creates no Docker activity or recovery worker.

properties.name: agent.code-execution.image
properties.description: Explicitly installed approved runtime, selected by immutable sha256 image ID or repository digest. No automatic pull or package installation.

properties.name: agent.code-execution.installation-id
properties.description: Stable installation identity, 8-64 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or hyphens; required for exact sandbox cleanup labels.

properties.name: agent.code-execution.docker-executable
properties.description: Operator-owned Docker CLI executable. Resource limits are fixed: 1 active sandbox, 4 queued, shared task deadline, 1 CPU, 512 MiB memory, 64 processes, 128 MiB writable storage, 64 KiB code and each output stream, 10 input/output files, 10 MiB per exported file and 25 MiB total inputs/exports.

properties.name: agent.secrets.enabled
properties.description: Enable account-owned encrypted credential management and authorized browser login tools. An absent or invalid encryption key leaves the vault unavailable.

properties.name: agent.secrets.key
properties.description: Active AES-256 encryption key: canonical padded Base64 for exactly 32 random bytes, without whitespace. Supply through the ignored .env or process environment; never commit or log it. Missing or invalid keys fail closed. Changes require restart.

properties.name: agent.secrets.key-id
properties.description: Identifier for the active encryption key, matching [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}. Use a new ID for each new key; retain earlier IDs with their original key material when rotating.

properties.name: agent.secrets.previous-keys
properties.description: Optional strict JSON object mapping up to 15 previous key IDs to canonical Base64-encoded 32-byte keys. Empty means no previous keys. Maximum 65536 characters; duplicate IDs, trailing data and the active key ID are rejected. Supply privately through .env or process environment; changes require restart.

properties.name: agent.secrets.max-records
properties.description: Maximum credential records per account including permanent deletion tombstones (1-500).

properties.name: agent.secrets.max-receipts
properties.description: Maximum retained atomic credential-management receipts per account (16-8192). Exhaustion rejects further writes without dropping reconciliation history.

properties.name: agent.learning.maximum-output-tokens
properties.description: Maximum permitted pinned profile output allowance for a bounded review; larger profiles fail before inference. Set at least as high as the configured model output allowance; this does not override provider max-tokens or the total review budget.

properties.name: agent.memory.enabled
properties.description: Enable durable fact tools and admission snapshots.

properties.name: agent.memory.user-enabled
properties.description: Permit user fact stores within the complete owner scope.

properties.name: agent.memory.environment-enabled
properties.description: Permit environment fact stores within the complete owner scope.

properties.name: agent.memory.user-max-chars
properties.description: Maximum rendered user facts in UTF-16 code units including entry delimiters.

properties.name: agent.memory.environment-max-chars
properties.description: Maximum rendered environment facts in UTF-16 code units including entry delimiters.

properties.name: agent.memory.max-receipts
properties.description: Bound atomic mutation receipts; exhaustion fails closed without dropping unsettled identities.

properties.name: agent.memory.max-proposals
properties.description: Maximum pending fact proposals per store.

properties.name: agent.memory.max-writes-per-execution
properties.description: Bound fact writes in restricted learning reviews. Ordinary user tasks have no attempt-count cutoff.

properties.name: agent.skills.enabled
properties.description: Enable versioned skill tools and admission index.

properties.name: agent.skills.self-check-enabled
properties.description: Before a root task's final answer is accepted, if the task loaded a skill, run one extra model turn that may patch that skill. The answer given before the check is delivered unchanged. Skipped with under 60 seconds of active time left.

properties.name: agent.skills.maximum-core-chars
properties.description: Maximum complete skill core instructions in UTF-16 code units.

properties.name: agent.skills.maximum-index-chars
properties.description: Maximum rendered owner skill routing index in UTF-16 code units.

properties.name: agent.skills.maximum-reference-chars
properties.description: Maximum inert supporting reference text in UTF-16 code units.

properties.name: agent.skills.maximum-skills
properties.description: Maximum skills per complete owner scope.

properties.name: agent.skills.retained-versions
properties.description: Maximum immutable versions retained per skill.

properties.name: agent.history.search-enabled
properties.description: Enable lexical message projection and message search tools.

properties.name: agent.history.maximum-indexed-executions-per-pass
properties.description: Maximum canonical executions projected in each background pass.

properties.name: agent.history.maximum-indexed-message-chars
properties.description: Bound searchable prefix of a single original message; original content stays authoritative.

properties.name: agent.learning.enabled
properties.description: Enable acknowledged-interaction reflection using an independent durable review journal.

properties.name: agent.learning.fact-review-every-user-turns
properties.description: Successfully acknowledged user turns per owner before fact review. 1 reviews facts after every acknowledged turn.

properties.name: agent.learning.profile-review-every-fact-reviews
properties.description: Completed fact reviews between refreshes of the derived user profile.

properties.name: agent.learning.curator-every-days
properties.description: Days between curator reviews that may propose retiring stale or duplicate agent-managed skills. 0 disables the curator.

properties.name: agent.memory.profile-enabled
properties.description: Keep a derived user profile: one bounded paragraph of model inference refreshed by background profile reviews and loaded under the saved facts. Tasks cannot write it.

properties.name: agent.memory.profile-max-chars
properties.description: Capacity of the derived user profile in UTF-16 code units.

properties.name: agent.learning.notifications
properties.description: Learning notice posted to the source Slack thread after a review saves or stages something: off, on (counts only) or verbose (one line per change). Console-origin tasks are never notified; the Journey view shows them.

properties.name: agent.learning.skill-review-every-tool-iterations
properties.description: Completed accepted response tool batches per owner before skill review.

properties.name: agent.learning.maximum-input-chars
properties.description: Maximum original interaction characters offered to a review.

properties.name: agent.learning.maximum-total-tokens
properties.description: Cumulative review token ceiling including conservative unknown usage reservations.

properties.name: agent.learning.maximum-millis
properties.description: Maximum active review duration in milliseconds.

properties.name: agent.learning.maximum-model-turns
properties.description: Maximum provider attempts per review.

properties.name: agent.learning.maximum-tool-calls
properties.description: Maximum review tool calls.

properties.name: agent.learning.worker-enabled
properties.description: Run the process-local durable review queue when learning is enabled; independent of JobRunr.

properties.name: agent.learning.profile
properties.description: Inference profile that runs reviews (for example default or cloud-fallback). Empty uses each source task's pinned profile. Startup fails when the named profile is not configured.

properties.name: agent.learning.maximum-interaction-chars
properties.description: Maximum characters of one acknowledged interaction's digest (request, corrections, tool outcomes, answer and recent messages) offered to a review. At most agent.learning.maximum-input-chars.

properties.name: agent.learning.maximum-review-interactions
properties.description: Maximum number of most recent acknowledged interactions offered to one review.

properties.name: agent.learning.maximum-consecutive-failures
properties.description: Failed reviews of one mode in a row before the cadence watermark advances past their inputs instead of re-reviewing them.

properties.name: agent.delegation.enabled
properties.description: Enable sequential internal child conversations sharing root authority, capacity and delivery.

properties.name: agent.delegation.max-children
properties.description: Lifetime child count, including failed and superseded children; minimum 1.

properties.name: agent.delegation.max-objective-chars
properties.description: Maximum focused assignment length in Unicode code points; minimum 1.

properties.name: agent.delegation.max-context-chars
properties.description: Maximum optional untrusted parent context length in Unicode code points; minimum 1.

properties.name: agent.delegation.max-references
properties.description: Maximum typed immutable references in one assignment; minimum 1.

properties.name: agent.delegation.max-result-bytes
properties.description: Complete serialized UTF-8 child result allowance; minimum 512 bytes, bounded by parent preview, context and child state allowances.

properties.name: agent.delegation.max-child-state-bytes
properties.description: Complete serialized UTF-8 nested state allowance per child; minimum 16384 bytes, including native blocks, calls and receipts.

properties.name: agent.delegation.max-aggregate-state-bytes
properties.description: Complete serialized UTF-8 child-map allowance; at least the per-child allowance, subject to MongoDB document capacity.

properties.name: agent.research.enabled
properties.description: Register execution-owned research and report tools; stored catalog tools remain available independently.

properties.name: agent.research.direct-fetch-enabled
properties.description: Permit controlled document HTTP GET retrieval without enabling Chromium.

properties.name: agent.research.allowed-hosts
properties.description: Exact direct-fetch host allowlist; empty permits public destinations. Each redirect is checked.

properties.name: agent.research.private-origins
properties.description: Explicit exact direct-fetch private origins. Operator API paths remain blocked.

properties.name: agent.research.max-task-requests
properties.description: Durable maximum direct-fetch requests per task, including redirects and failures.

properties.name: agent.research.fetch-timeout
properties.description: Standalone direct-fetch deadline including queue and redirect time. Task fetches inherit the remaining task deadline.

properties.name: agent.research.max-redirects
properties.description: Maximum separately checked direct-fetch redirects.

properties.name: agent.research.max-concurrent-downloads
properties.description: Process-wide concurrent controlled downloads.

properties.name: agent.research.max-extracted-chars
properties.description: Maximum extracted text characters per document.

properties.name: agent.research.max-expanded-bytes
properties.description: Maximum decompressed DOCX content bytes inspected by the passive document parser.

properties.name: agent.research.max-archive-entries
properties.description: Maximum DOCX ZIP entries; general archive extraction is unsupported.

properties.name: agent.research.extraction-timeout
properties.description: Standalone cooperative non-PDF extraction deadline. Task extraction inherits the remaining task deadline; parser settlement remains tracked.

properties.name: agent.research.max-artifacts
properties.description: Maximum managed source, evidence, document and report artifacts per task.

properties.name: agent.research.max-report-bytes
properties.description: Maximum deterministic Markdown report bytes.

properties.name: agent.research.max-output-file-bytes
properties.description: Maximum bytes of one output file the task stages for the requester with task_attach_file or browser_screenshot.

properties.name: agent.uploads.enabled
properties.description: Accept files attached to task requests in the operator console or to Slack messages. Disabled, a request or message carrying files is rejected.

properties.name: agent.uploads.max-files
properties.description: Maximum files attached to one task request or Slack message, and to one task in all, 1 to 100.

properties.name: agent.uploads.max-file-bytes
properties.description: Maximum decoded bytes of one attached file, minimum 1024. Also the ceiling for console downloads of stored files.

properties.name: agent.uploads.max-total-bytes
properties.description: Maximum decoded bytes of all files attached to one task request or Slack message, and to one task in all; sets the request body ceiling of POST /api/agent/executions (Base64 overhead plus 1 MiB).

properties.name: agent.research.files.pdfinfo-command
properties.description: Installed Poppler pdfinfo executable name or absolute path; never a shell command line. Used lazily when reading a PDF.

properties.name: agent.research.files.render-command
properties.description: Installed Poppler pdftoppm executable name or absolute path for bounded PNG page rendering; never a shell command line.

properties.name: agent.research.files.pdftotext-command
properties.description: Installed Poppler pdftotext executable name or absolute path for bounded text-layer extraction of PDF documents on providers without native document input.

properties.name: agent.research.files.max-units
properties.description: Maximum file units processed through the selected InferenceService, minimum 1. Units are rendered PDF pages or bounded text sections.

properties.name: agent.research.files.page-dimension
properties.description: Maximum rendered PNG page dimension in pixels, minimum 512.

properties.name: agent.research.files.max-page-image-bytes
properties.description: Maximum rendered PNG bytes for one page, minimum 1024.

properties.name: agent.research.files.max-output-chars-per-unit
properties.description: Maximum model output characters per file unit, minimum 1000; total extracted text and inference token limits also apply.

properties.name: agent.research.files.timeout
properties.description: Standalone file preprocessing and inference deadline, at least one second. Task calls inherit the remaining task deadline.

properties.name: agent.scheduling.enabled
properties.description: Enable durable agent schedules through AGENT_SCHEDULING_ENABLED. The JobRunr background worker is enabled separately and requires a persistent store.

properties.name: agent.scheduling.maximum-lateness
properties.description: Allowed recurring queue lateness before skipping an occurrence. One-time occurrences may run once after recovery.

properties.name: slack.enabled
properties.description: Enable the single-workspace Slack Socket Mode bot. Requires bot and app-level tokens.

properties.name: slack.bot-token
properties.description: Slack bot OAuth token (xoxb-), supplied through SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.

properties.name: slack.app-token
properties.description: Slack app-level token (xapp-) with connections:write, supplied through SLACK_APP_TOKEN.

properties.name: slack.workers
properties.description: Maximum concurrent Slack ingress dispatch workers, minimum 1. Agent workers are managed separately.

properties.name: slack.queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum waiting Slack ingress events, minimum 1. Socket envelopes are acknowledged before asynchronous dispatch.

properties.name: inference.provider
properties.description: Explicit inference provider: claude, openai, or llama-cpp. Empty leaves agent tasks and the inference playground unavailable.

properties.name: inference.primary.context-capacity
properties.description: Explicit context capacity required when a default provider is selected. Zero leaves capacity undeclared; otherwise input allowance, provider max-tokens, and safety margin must fit.

properties.name: inference.primary.input-allowance
properties.description: Explicit positive input allowance required when a default provider is selected. Built-in providers use native input-token counts plus 2048 tokens of headroom; custom providers without counting retain a conservative byte estimate. Separate from the cumulative task token budget.

properties.name: inference.primary.safety-margin
properties.description: Explicit nonnegative unused context reserve required when a default provider is selected; validated against a declared context capacity.

properties.name: inference.cloud-fallback.enabled
properties.description: Explicitly admit one hosted continuation profile for new local tasks exceeding their per-request input allowance. Disabled settings are not bound or validated and create no hosted SDK client. Does not enable failure retries or change existing task limits.

properties.name: inference.cloud-fallback.provider
properties.description: Exactly one hosted continuation provider, openai or claude; required only when enabled. Uses the selected provider's existing OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

properties.name: inference.cloud-fallback.model
properties.description: Hosted model identifier required only when cloud continuation is enabled. Verify model context/output limits and account availability before configuring.

properties.name: inference.cloud-fallback.context-capacity
properties.description: Explicit hosted model context capacity required when cloud continuation is enabled. Zero leaves capacity undeclared; otherwise input allowance, output reserve, and safety margin must fit.

properties.name: inference.cloud-fallback.input-allowance
properties.description: Explicit positive input allowance per cloud continuation request, using the hosted provider's native input-token count plus 2048 tokens of headroom. Required when enabled; actual handoff must also fit the remaining task token budget (the task token ceiling for ordinary tasks, the cumulative token limit for monitoring).

properties.name: inference.cloud-fallback.output-reserve
properties.description: Explicit positive hosted maximum output tokens and per-request output reservation required when cloud continuation is enabled, including reasoning where applicable. Must fit the selected model output limit and any declared context capacity.

properties.name: inference.cloud-fallback.safety-margin
properties.description: Explicit nonnegative unused context reserve required when cloud continuation is enabled.

properties.name: inference.claude.model
properties.description: Explicit Anthropic model identifier required when the Claude provider is selected.

properties.name: inference.claude.max-tokens
properties.description: Explicit maximum output tokens required when Claude is selected. Must be positive and within the model's output limit. Large budgets may require streaming with the Anthropic SDK.

properties.name: inference.openai.model
properties.description: Explicit OpenAI model identifier required when OpenAI is selected for Responses API requests.

properties.name: inference.openai.max-tokens
properties.description: Explicit maximum output tokens required when OpenAI is selected, including reasoning tokens. Must be positive and within the selected model's output limit; this is not its context capacity.

properties.name: inference.llama-cpp.base-url
properties.description: Explicit base URL required when llama.cpp is selected, including the /v1 path of the llama-server OpenAI-compatible API.

properties.name: inference.llama-cpp.model
properties.description: Explicit loaded model name or --alias configured on llama-server, required when llama.cpp is selected.

properties.name: inference.llama-cpp.max-tokens
properties.description: Explicit maximum output tokens required when llama.cpp is selected. Must be positive and fit the server's per-slot context capacity alongside input and safety allowances.

properties.name: inference.llama-cpp.api-key
properties.description: Optional llama-server API key supplied through LLAMA_CPP_API_KEY; explicitly set a blank value for servers with authentication disabled.

properties.name: agent.automatic-resumption
properties.description: Resume running tasks after settlement recovery; false blocks interrupted work without replay.

properties.name: agent.limits.total-tokens
properties.description: Cumulative cap for restricted workflows. Ordinary user tasks ignore this cap while still recording usage.

properties.name: agent.limits.active-millis
properties.description: Shared active-time allowance for a task, including inference, tools and children. Default 30 minutes; ordinary tasks have no shorter operation deadline.

properties.name: agent.limits.model-turns
properties.description: Request cap for restricted workflows. Ordinary user tasks ignore this cap.

properties.name: agent.limits.tool-calls
properties.description: Dispatch cap for restricted workflows. Ordinary user tasks ignore this cap.

properties.name: agent.limits.tool-timeout-millis
properties.description: Operation ceiling for restricted workflows. Ordinary task operations inherit remaining task time.

properties.name: agent.limits.task-token-ceiling
properties.description: Total charged tokens, including child runs and unsettled reservations, at which an ordinary user task stops as partial with reason task_token_ceiling and starts no further model request. 0 disables the ceiling. Monitoring and learning work keep their own budgets.

properties.name: agent.browser.enabled
properties.description: Enable Browser Use's native DOM/action backend with isolated execution-owned Chromium sessions. Startup is lazy; pinned Python and locked Node/Chromium dependencies must be installed.

properties.name: agent.browser.headless
properties.description: Launch isolated Browser Use Chromium sessions in headless mode.

properties.name: agent.browser.node-executable
properties.description: Operator-controlled Node.js executable used to provision and guard the isolated Chromium process. Model arguments cannot change this path.

properties.name: agent.browser.python-executable
properties.description: Operator-controlled Python executable with pinned Browser Use dependencies installed. Provider credentials and developer .env settings are not passed to the process.

properties.name: agent.browser.launcher-script
properties.description: Operator-controlled trusted launcher for guarded Chromium and the Browser Use stdio bridge. Install runtime/browser-use-runtime's pinned Python and locked Node dependencies before use; task execution never installs packages.

properties.name: agent.browser.allowed-hosts
properties.description: Optional exact destination host allowlist; no wildcards, ports, or suffix matches. Private networks remain blocked without exact private-origins overrides.

properties.name: agent.browser.private-origins
properties.description: Exact HTTP(S) origins allowed to access private networks, with Chromium local-network permission scoped to each configured origin. Scheme, host, and effective port must match; protected operator paths remain denied. No paths, credentials, query strings, fragments, or wildcards.

properties.name: agent.monitoring.maximum-active-jobs
properties.description: Maximum open monitoring jobs per registered Velocity account.

properties.name: agent.monitoring.concurrent-runs
properties.description: Maximum unfinished monitoring runs in this single-process installation.

properties.name: agent.monitoring.minimum-cadence
properties.description: Minimum interval between monitoring checks; validated cron gaps and dispatch admission enforce it.

properties.name: agent.monitoring.tool-calls
properties.description: Maximum accepted tool calls per monitoring run, further reduced by ordinary agent limits.

properties.name: agent.monitoring.results
properties.description: Maximum observations and candidate updates in one structured monitoring result.

properties.name: agent.monitoring.run-duration
properties.description: Monitoring run active-time budget and reconciliation wall-clock deadline.

properties.name: agent.monitoring.total-tokens
properties.description: Maximum inference tokens per monitoring run, capped by ordinary agent limits.

properties.name: agent.monitoring.output-reserve
properties.description: Output tokens one monitoring model request may generate and reserves against the run's token budget, never above the pinned profile's maximum output. Sizes the reserve kept for the final report.

properties.name: agent.monitoring.model-turns
properties.description: Maximum model turns per monitoring check.

properties.name: agent.monitoring.notification-chars
properties.description: Maximum notification UTF-16 characters, minimum 1000. Digests include complete queued entries only.

properties.name: agent.monitoring.retention
properties.description: Age threshold for pruning settled monitoring history. Current item evidence and unresolved work remain pinned.

properties.name: agent.monitoring.retained-runs
properties.description: Minimum recent monitoring runs and maximum settled embedded schedule occurrences to retain, minimum 1.

Operator-assigned version of the explicit USD price catalog. Application defaults combine manually verified public prices dated 2026-10-02 (GPT-6 Luna) and 2026-10-16 (Claude) with operator-chosen zero rates for the exact local Qwen model. Each request pins the catalog; changes never reprice prior requests.
properties.name: usage.pricing-version

properties.description: At most 256 explicit provider/model prices. Application defaults cover GPT-6 Luna, Claude Haiku 4.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5 using dated public Standard rates, plus operator-chosen zero rates for llama-cpp/qwen-local (the llama-server response alias); local zero rates are an accounting choice, not a vendor-published price. No automatic fetching. Exact response model IDs; other unconfigured models, including local models, remain unpriced. Override as a complete list.
properties.name: usage.prices

properties.description: Explicit pricing provider: openai, claude, or llama-cpp. Does not select inference routing.
properties.name: usage.prices[].provider

properties.description: Exact actual provider response model ID. Missing prices remain unknown, including local inference.
properties.name: usage.prices[].model

properties.description: Required nonnegative USD estimate per million ordinary input tokens, excluding cached input.
properties.name: usage.prices[].input-per-million

properties.description: Required nonnegative USD estimate per million output tokens, including reasoning already present in output totals.
properties.name: usage.prices[].output-per-million

properties.description: Optional USD estimate per million cache-read input tokens; absent positive cache usage is explicitly unpriced.
properties.name: usage.prices[].cache-read-per-million

properties.description: Optional USD estimate per million cache-creation tokens without a reported duration. Does not substitute for five-minute or one-hour rates.
properties.name: usage.prices[].cache-creation-per-million

properties.description: Optional USD estimate per million five-minute cache-creation tokens.
properties.name: usage.prices[].cache-creation5m-per-million

properties.description: Optional USD estimate per million one-hour cache-creation tokens.
properties.name: usage.prices[].cache-creation1h-per-million

properties.description: Optional long-context pricing rule. A request strictly above its input-token threshold uses multiplied rates for the entire request; the rule is pinned with its catalog.
properties.name: usage.prices[].long-context

properties.description: Positive normalized input-token threshold, including cache tokens. Multipliers apply only when input tokens strictly exceed this value.
properties.name: usage.prices[].long-context.input-token-threshold

properties.description: Positive decimal multiplier for ordinary input and every configured cache rate above the threshold, applied to all input tokens in that request.
properties.name: usage.prices[].long-context.input-multiplier

properties.description: Positive decimal multiplier for all output tokens, including reasoning, when the input-token threshold is exceeded.
properties.name: usage.prices[].long-context.output-multiplier
inference.claude.prompt-caching
properties.description: Mark the system prompt, the tool definitions and the latest conversation turn as ephemeral cache breakpoints on every Claude request so the stable prefix of an agent loop is read from the provider's prompt cache. Applies to the default Claude profile and the Claude cloud continuation.

properties.name: web-search.enabled
properties.description: Register the web_search tool backed by the configured search provider. Enabling it without an API key fails startup.

properties.name: web-search.provider
properties.description: Search provider; tavily is the only supported value.

properties.name: web-search.api-key
properties.description: Tavily API key, sent only as a bearer header to the configured base URL. Supply it through the ignored .env or the process environment.

properties.name: web-search.base-url
properties.description: HTTPS origin of the Tavily Search API without a trailing slash.

properties.name: web-search.max-content-chars
properties.description: Characters of each result excerpt placed in the tool result (200 to 8000).

properties.name: web-search.max-results
properties.description: Results returned when the model does not ask for a count (1 to 10).

properties.name: web-search.request-timeout
properties.description: Upper bound for one search request, further capped by the task's remaining time.

properties.name: web-search.search-depth
properties.description: Tavily search depth: basic (one credit) or advanced (two credits, more relevant excerpts).

properties.name: mcp.enabled
properties.description: Connect to the configured Model Context Protocol servers at startup and register their tools as mcp_<server>_<tool>. Enabling it without an mcp.servers entry fails startup; an unreachable server is reported in status instead.

properties.name: mcp.connect-timeout
properties.description: Upper bound for starting or reaching one server and completing MCP initialization during startup discovery and later reconnects (1s to 10m).

properties.name: mcp.request-timeout
properties.description: Upper bound for one tool call to an MCP server, further capped by the task's remaining time (1s to 10m). A server entry may override it with mcp.servers[n].request-timeout.

properties.name: mcp.max-result-chars
properties.description: Characters of text an MCP tool result may carry into the task before it is truncated (1000 to 1000000). A server entry may override it with mcp.servers[n].max-result-chars; a response several times larger fails the call.

properties.name: mcp.confirm-writes
properties.description: Hold every MCP tool that is not a read for the requester's approval, with a preview of the exact call, even while agent.approval is disabled. Unattended runs are never paused.

properties.name: mcp.servers
properties.description: Indexed list of MCP servers (mcp.servers[0].name, .transport (stdio or http), .command, .args, .directory, .environment.*, .url, .headers.*, .tools, .category, .request-timeout, .max-result-chars). Declared in .env or the environment; see docs/mcp.md.

properties.name: agent.approval.enabled
properties.description: Pause a task before dispatching a tool call that matches the approval categories or tool list until the operator approves or declines it. Monitoring runs and delegated children are denied such calls instead of waiting.

properties.name: agent.approval.categories
properties.description: Comma-separated tool categories whose calls require approval. Reads, questions and delegation never require approval.

properties.name: agent.approval.tools
properties.description: Comma-separated tool names that always require approval, whatever their category.

properties.name: agent.approval.exempt-tools
properties.description: Comma-separated tool names that never require approval even when their category matches.

properties.name: agent.live-output.model-streaming
properties.description: Stream each model turn on providers that support streaming so assistant text reaches the console live. False requests complete responses; saved task changes are still pushed over server-sent events.

properties.name: example.enabled
properties.description: Enable the example feature module's read-only example_echo tool. Only meaningful in a build packaged with -Pexample-feature; the default build does not contain the module.
